SELECT contact_type AS contactType, contact_id AS contactId, MAX(last_message) AS lastMessage, MAX(last_message_time) AS lastMessageTime FROM ( -- 我发送的消息（对方是联系人） SELECT receiver_type AS contact_type, receiver_id AS contact_id, content AS last_message, create_time AS last_message_time FROM message WHERE sender_type = #{userType} AND sender_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND msg_type = 3
UNION ALL
-- 我收到的消息（对方是联系人） SELECT sender_type AS contact_type, sender_id AS contact_id, content AS last_message, create_time AS last_message_time FROM message WHERE receiver_type = #{userType} AND receiver_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND msg_type = 3 ) AS combined GROUP BY contact_type, contact_id ORDER BY MAX(last_message_time) DESC

SELECT DISTINCT 3 AS contactType, i.id AS contactId, i.name AS contactName, i.logo AS contactAvatar, i.contact_phone AS contactPhone FROM institution i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 1 AND i.id IN ( -- 有预约记录的机构 SELECT DISTINCT institution_id FROM appointment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 UNION -- 有护理计划的机构（通过宝宝关联） SELECT DISTINCT cp.institution_id FROM care_plan cp INNER JOIN baby b ON cp.baby_id = b.id WHERE b.parent_id = #{parentId} AND cp.deleted = 0 AND b.deleted = 0 UNION -- 有订单的机构 SELECT DISTINCT institution_id FROM orders WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 )
AND (i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.contact_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY i.name

SELECT DISTINCT 2 AS contactType, n.id AS contactId, n.real_name AS contactName, n.avatar AS contactAvatar, n.phone AS contactPhone FROM nanny n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 1 AND n.id IN ( -- 护理计划中分配的保姆 SELECT DISTINCT cp.nanny_id FROM care_plan cp INNER JOIN baby b ON cp.baby_id = b.id WHERE b.parent_id = #{parentId} AND cp.deleted = 0 AND b.deleted = 0 AND cp.nanny_id IS NOT NULL UNION -- 预约中分配的保姆 SELECT DISTINCT nanny_id FROM appointment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 AND nanny_id IS NOT NULL )
AND (n.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY n.real_name

SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS contactType, p.id AS contactId, p.real_name AS contactName, p.avatar AS contactAvatar, p.phone AS contactPhone FROM parent p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.id IN ( -- 护理计划中服务的家长（通过宝宝关联） SELECT DISTINCT b.parent_id FROM care_plan cp INNER JOIN baby b ON cp.baby_id = b.id WHERE cp.nanny_id = #{nannyId} AND cp.deleted = 0 AND b.deleted = 0 UNION -- 预约中服务的家长 SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM appointment WHERE nanny_id = #{nannyId} AND deleted = 0 )
AND (p.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.real_name

SELECT 3 AS contactType, i.id AS contactId, i.name AS contactName, i.logo AS contactAvatar, i.contact_phone AS contactPhone FROM institution i INNER JOIN nanny n ON n.institution_id = i.id WHERE n.id = #{nannyId} AND n.deleted = 0 AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS contactType, p.id AS contactId, p.real_name AS contactName, p.avatar AS contactAvatar, p.phone AS contactPhone FROM parent p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.id IN ( -- 有预约记录的家长 SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM appointment WHERE institution_id = #{institutionId} AND deleted = 0 UNION -- 有护理计划的家长（通过宝宝关联） SELECT DISTINCT b.parent_id FROM care_plan cp INNER JOIN baby b ON cp.baby_id = b.id WHERE cp.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND cp.deleted = 0 AND b.deleted = 0 UNION -- 有订单的家长 SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM orders WHERE institution_id = #{institutionId} AND deleted = 0 )
AND (p.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.real_name

SELECT 1 AS contactType, p.id AS contactId, p.real_name AS contactName, p.avatar AS contactAvatar, p.phone AS contactPhone FROM parent p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND (p.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
